daily.name: 运动指数
daily.text: 天气较好，户外运动请注意防晒。推荐您进行室内运动。

daily.name: 洗车指数
daily.text: 较适宜洗车，未来一天无雨，风力较小，擦洗一新的汽车至少能保持一天。

daily.name: 穿衣指数
daily.text: 建议着长袖T恤、衬衫加单裤等服装。年老体弱者宜着针织长袖衬衫、马甲和长裤。

daily.name: 钓鱼指数
daily.text: 白天风和日丽，适宜垂钓，渺渺蓝天，悠悠白云将陪伴你度过愉快的垂钓时光。

daily.name: 紫外线指数
daily.text: 紫外线强度较弱，建议出门前涂擦SPF在12-15之间、PA+的防晒护肤品。

daily.name: 旅游指数
daily.text: 天气较好，温度适宜，是个好天气哦。这样的天气适宜旅游，您可以尽情地享受大自然的风光。

daily.name: 过敏指数
daily.text: 天气条件极易诱发过敏，易过敏人群尽量减少外出，外出宜穿长衣长裤并佩戴好眼镜和口罩，外出归来时及时清洁手和口鼻。

daily.name: 舒适度指数
daily.text: 白天天气晴好，您在这种天气条件下，会感觉早晚凉爽、舒适，午后偏热。

daily.name: 感冒指数
daily.text: 各项气象条件适宜，无明显降温过程，发生感冒机率较低。

daily.name: 空气污染扩散条件指数
daily.text: 气象条件较不利于空气污染物稀释、扩散和清除，请适当减少室外活动时间。

daily.name: 空调开启指数
daily.text: 您将感到很舒适，一般不需要开启空调。

daily.name: 太阳镜指数
daily.text: 白天天空晴朗，太阳辐射很强，建议佩戴透射比2级且标注UV400的遮阳镜

daily.name: 化妆指数
daily.text: 建议用蜜质SPF20面霜打底，水质无油粉底霜。

daily.name: 晾晒指数
daily.text: 天气不错，较适宜晾晒，但风力偏大，请选择避风地点晾晒衣物并夹牢衣物。

daily.name: 交通指数
daily.text: 天气较好，路面干燥，交通气象条件良好，车辆可以正常行驶。

daily.name: 防晒指数
daily.text: 属强紫外辐射天气，外出时应加强防护，建议涂擦SPF在15-20之间，PA++的防晒护肤品。

daily.name: Sport
daily.text: The weather is good, please pay attention to sun protection if you exercise outdoors. We recommend you to do indoor sports.

daily.name: Car Wash
daily.text: Better for car washing, no rain in the coming day, less wind, scrubbing a new car can keep at least a day.

daily.name: Dressing
daily.text: Long-sleeved T-shirts, shirts and single pants are recommended. Long-sleeved knitted shirts, vests and long pants are recommended for the elderly and infirm.

daily.name: Fishing
daily.text: Windy and beautiful day, suitable for fishing, small blue sky, long white clouds will accompany you to spend a pleasant fishing time.

daily.name: UV Index
daily.text: Weak UV radiation, it is recommended to apply sunscreen skin care products with SPF between 12-15 and PA+ before going out.

daily.name: Travel
daily.text: The weather is good, the temperature is good, it is a good weather oh. Such weather is good for traveling and you can enjoy the nature to the fullest.

daily.name: Allergy
daily.text: Weather conditions are extremely allergy-prone. Allergy-prone people should try to go out less, wear long clothes and pants, wear glasses and masks, and clean their hands and nose and mouth when they come back from going out.

daily.name: Comfort
daily.text: The weather is sunny during the day and you will feel cool and comfortable in the morning and evening and hot in the afternoon under these weather conditions.

daily.name: Flu
daily.text: The weather conditions are favorable and there is no significant cooling process, so the chance of catching a cold is low.

daily.name: Air Pollution
daily.text: Weather conditions are unfavorable to the dilution, dispersion and removal of air pollutants, please reduce the time of outdoor activities as appropriate.

daily.name: Air-Conditioner
daily.text: You will feel very comfortable and generally do not need to turn on the air conditioner.

daily.name: Sun Glasses
daily.text: The sky is clear during the day, the sun radiation is very strong, it is recommended to wear the transmission ratio of 2 and marked UV400 sun shades

daily.name: Make Up
daily.text: Recommended to use honey quality SPF20 cream foundation and water quality oil-free foundation.

daily.name: Air-Cure
daily.text: The weather is good, more suitable for drying, but the wind is strong, please choose a windy place to dry clothes and clip the clothes.

daily.name: Traffic
daily.text: The weather is better, the road is dry, traffic and weather conditions are good, vehicles can drive normally.

daily.name: SPF
daily.text: In strong UV radiation weather, it is recommended to wear sunscreen with SPF between 15-20 and PA++ when going out.
